title: Burst Pipe — Mooki Street, Pimville Zone 2
description: Joburg Water teams are repairing a burst water pipe on Mooki Street. Water supply to Pimville Zone 2 affected. Alternative water is available at Pimville Community Hall. Expected completion: 18:00.

title: Planned Maintenance — Diepkloof Zone 4
description: Scheduled water maintenance in Diepkloof Zone 4 on 12 June 2026 from 08:00 to 16:00. Water supply will be interrupted. Store water in advance.
